info.description: Return-window configuration, one row per app (keyed by app_slug) with one row flagged is_default. Per-product opt-out stays on product.non_returnable. Future: per-category / per-channel scope rows.

app_slug.description: App this policy applies to (e.g. web, pos). Resolution is by app_slug first, then the is_default row. Left empty the row is only reachable by documentId.

is_default.description: Fallback policy used when no app_slug matches. Exactly one row carries this — setting it on a row clears it on the others.

policy_text.description: Customer-visible policy copy rendered on the return-request form.
